Adding Ops context —

We ran a controlled regional failover drill on 2027-05-25 (can share play-by-play). Key points to surface in the summary:
- Failover choreography: DNS cut, orchestration re-route, model variant fallback; full traffic rehydration took ~4m40s in us-west on average.
- Control plane snapshot restore: automated restoration of route tables and secrets completed in under 6 minutes in 3/4 rehearsals (median 4m50s).
- For large-context models we pre-warm KV shards in parallel; warm-up reduces median first-token latency by ~48% vs cold start in our test corpus.

I've attached the rehearsal timing CSV (failover-timings-20270529.csv) and flagged the table that shows the 95th percentile. We're happy to annotate the summary PDF with those numbers.
